parameters.name: Expression
parameters.description: The alert whitelist rule. This is a JSON object.

parameters.name: IncidentUuid
parameters.description: The global unique ID of the event.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the Data Management center for threat analysis. Select a region for the Data Management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of the member. This parameter is used when an administrator switches to the perspective of a member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type.

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise.

parameters.name: WhiteRuleId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the whitelist rule.
